purpose: Decide whether a sensitive Silero threshold plus a periodic (voiced) confirmation gate can recover real meeting speech without adding non-speech false transcriptions, on real WenetSpeech TEST_MEETING speech with human references.

data.source: TwinkStart/WenetSpeech (HuggingFace mirror), split test_meeting, revision ec930f771e48837e9ec246b1e128a1662ab9ce87
data.license_caveat: Upstream WenetSpeech and underlying audio rights; original audio may include material the publisher does not own. Not asserted as production-deployable data.
data.independence_caveat: Exposed metadata encodes only a row index and speaker S00000; meeting/speaker disjointness and pretraining overlap CANNOT be established.

development_batches.name: devA
development_batches.note: previously viewed in meeting pilot; development/regression only

development_batches.name: devB
development_batches.note: previously viewed in meeting pilot; development/regression only

final_test.name: test
final_test.note: never viewed before freezing this file; audio/text fingerprints verified disjoint from devA, devB and both prior viewed batches

noise_controls.synthetic: 12 seeded white/pink noise probes plus digital silence (regression only)
noise_controls.real_test: ESC-50 fold 2 (prepare_noise), sources 101676/102567/104952/106072/18766/106014; src_file disjoint from fold 1
noise_controls.license_caveat: ESC-50 original audio is CC BY-NC 3.0; used only as local regression probes, not a real-world false-positive rate.

baseline: Application defaults: SenseVoice INT8 sherpa-onnx, Silero VAD threshold 0.4, recheck enabled, denoise off, num_threads 2, language zh, use_itn true.

periodic_gate.definition: After Silero reports at least one speech segment at the candidate threshold, compute the fraction of energetic 25 ms frames (10 ms hop, RMS floor 5e-4) whose normalised autocorrelation peak over lags 40-228 (pitch 70-400 Hz) is >= 0.45. Reject if voiced_fraction < 0.15 or if fewer than 20 energetic frames. Accept = candidate has speech segments AND gate passes.
periodic_gate.rationale: On the viewed data the lower threshold only ever RECOVERS speech and never alters the acoustic hypothesis on utterances 0.4 already accepted; the sole regression is a stationary-wind false transcription. Stationary noise (wind, silence, broadband) is aperiodic, so voiced_fraction separates it from speech. The check is deterministic and runs only on already-detected segments.
periodic_gate.measured_dev_separation: Real speech voiced_fraction >= 0.26 (min over 77 dev utterances at threshold 0.1); wind 0.01-0.10; silence/broadband 0; only periodic machinery (vacuum/engine) exceeds 0.15 but did not hallucinate text and is therefore not the false-positive driver.

frozen_selection_rule: Choose ONE candidate before final inference using development only: (a) non-speech false positives (all controls) must not exceed baseline; (b) lower combined dev CER wins; (c) tie broken by lower peak RTF. No final-test prediction may influence this choice.

acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.primary: final-test speech CER relative reduction vs baseline >= 5%
acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.significance: utterance-grouped paired bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0
acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.non_speech: final-test non-speech false positives (synthetic + fold-2 real noise + silence) do not exceed baseline (baseline expected 0)
acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.speech_recovery: no speech utterance accepted by baseline becomes empty under the candidate
acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.efficiency: peak RTF < 0.15 and marginal gate cost acceptable
acceptance_gate_for_default_recommendati.decision: Only if ALL pass may the candidate be recommended as a new default; otherwise keep threshold 0.4 + recheck and state the missing evidence.

explicitly_not_claimed: This is NOT a Raspberry Pi measurement; all timings/memory are on an Apple Silicon development machine.
Meeting/speaker independence and pretraining overlap are unproven.
The six fold-1/fold-2 ESC-50 recordings are regression probes, not a real-world false-positive rate.
No retraining is performed; the trained output-head experiments remain unproven and are not used.
